## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Emily is notably house-proud, maintaining a strict daily regimen of sweeping, dusting, and scouring to keep her home tidy. She is also a highly skilled dressmaker, recognized for her exceptional taste and unmatched ability to craft well-fitting garments.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_

## History

In her younger days, Emily worked as a schoolteacher before eventually owning a select boardinghouse at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). After being long-estranged from her husband, [James A](../character/james-a.md). [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), she arrived at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to reunite with him, quickly restoring his house and achieving a full reconciliation. Later, she hosted her relative [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) as a boarder at her [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) establishment.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P29](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0029), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), +6 more_

## Relationships

### [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--emily.md)

Emily interacts with [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) during her return to the village after reuniting with her long-estranged husband, [James](../character/james-a.md) [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md). Following the public revelation of her identity and their subsequent reconciliation, Emily joins Mrs. Sowerby, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for a friendly chat.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P29](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0029), +6 more_

- Friend of — enduring bond of friendship (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)</sub>

### [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cressy-lindsay--emily.md)

Emily is a relative of [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), being the second-cousin of Cressy's father. She hosts [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) as a guest at her boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), where [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) stays while recovering from health scares and writing to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about the household's eccentric older boarders.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Ezra P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Ezra P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Ezra P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), +1 more_

- Relative of — second-cousin of her father (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Ezra P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002)</sub>
